info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Event Notifications API
info.description: The Manage Event Notifications API facilitates the deletion of specific event notifications linked to webhook subscriptions. This operation allows consumers, such as developers and system administrators, to maintain control over which events trigger notifications by removing unnecessary or outdated entries. Users can manage notifications efficiently by pinpointing the exact event and webhook combination to delete. This can be particularly beneficial for applications that require dynamic event handling and customization based on user preferences.

delete.summary: Delete a specific event from a webhook.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specified event associated with a webhook identified by its unique resource ID. It’s crucial for maintaining the integrity and relevancy of webhook events in your system.

requestBody.description: Payload that contains the necessary details for deleting the specified event. Ensure relevant identifiers are included to accurately reference the event for removal.

204.description: Successfully deleted the requested resource with no content returned.

DeleteWebhookEventRes100045Request.description: A string representation of the request body for the DELETE operation on webhook events.

DeleteWebhookEventRes100045Response_204.description: This schema represents the response format for a successful delete operation on the specified webhook event resource.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes the Bearer authentication method with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). JWT tokens are used to authenticate users and authorize access to protected resources.
